page.overview:
Who is Atz Yuminor?

Atz Yuminor was a heroic wizard who lived during the Age of Arcanum. In his lifetime, he assisted in killing the crazed wizard Clemain Astural and took with him many of Astural's scrolls, which were brought back to his house in the Dividing Plains. He is the namesake of Westruun's Yuminor Observatory and the Scions of Yuminor, which is funded by the headmistress of the Westhall Academy, Yuminor's descendant Estella Ladimar.

Category:Articles with verified appearances
